newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-PALMER TREATED FOR CANCER AT MAYO CLINIC.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-PALMER TREATED FOR CANCER AT MAYO CLINIC.

text.p: Doctors at the Mayo Clinic said Monday they were encouraged by initial tests on Arnold Palmer who entered the facility for treatment of prostate cancer.
The 67-year-old Palmer announced Friday night in Carslbad, California, that he had been diagnosed with the disease.
The clinic issued a statement saying Palmer was undergoing evaluation and "physicians are encouraged by initial test results."
Prostate cancer is a slow-developing form of the disease that can usually be successfully treated if detected early.

Palmer won four Masters titles, two British Opens and one U.S. Open in his legendary career. Credited with popularising the game in the television era, Palmer ranks fourth on the all-time PGA Tour victory list with 60 titles and has won 10 Senior Tournaments.
